home.heroTitle: Robotics and embedded systems, built side by side.
home.heroSubtitle: Two engineers sharing one practice — firmware, control, and hardware that has to hold up in the field.
home.capabilitiesSubtitle: From bare-metal firmware to closed-loop control — systems designed to ship and stay running.
home.capabilityEmbeddedDesc: Bare-metal and RTOS firmware on MCUs and SoCs — timing-critical, resource-constrained, production-ready.
home.capabilityRoboticsDesc: Kinematics, sensor fusion, and real-time control loops for mobile and manipulator platforms.
home.capabilityFirmwareDesc: Modular drivers, protocol stacks, and OTA-ready codebases built for long maintenance cycles.
home.capabilityHardwareDesc: Schematic-to-PCB bring-up, signal integrity, and tight software–hardware co-design.
